name: AsahiKasei KARAKSA-F PA-CNF DX @X-Max 4-Series
filament_notes: Asahi Kasei KARAKSA-F PA-CNF DX (DX205): cellulose nanofiber reinforced polyamide. PA6-CF is retained only as the QIDI printer/BOX compatibility category; this product contains CNF, not carbon fiber. MAX4 0.4 mm profile: nozzle 275 C, PEI/hot/engineering bed 65 C, flow ratio 0.96, conservative volumetric limit 12 mm3/s. Based on a user-supplied profile and a physical MAX4 flow test with QIDI BOX; 12 mm3/s is a conservative selected value, not a measured failure threshold or a manufacturer-certified flow rate. Nozzle range 260-280 C follows manufacturer guidance and bounds the HOTENDTEMP parameter in BOX_PRINT_START. Density 1.16 g/cm3 and diameter 1.75 mm follow the publicly downloadable DX205 TDS CNFF-TD002-1. No required nozzle hardness; active chamber/BOX heating and pressure advance override are off. Pre-dry the filament and use PA-compatible bed adhesive. Other nozzle sizes and printer models require separate calibration. Manufacturer information: https://www.asahi-kasei.co.jp/karaksa/products/pa-filament.html Public TDS: https://filament2print.com/en/index.php?controller=attachment&id_attachment=3734
filament_start_gcode: ; QIDI Studio: fan and chamber control are handled by the selected printer profile.
